run_finetune_training: run the Kronos basemodel fine-tuning CLI with a YAML config file for financial kline data
train_model: train the Kronos predictor model with AdamW optimizer, OneCycleLR scheduler, and DDP support
create_dataloaders: create train and validation DataLoaders from CSV kline data with time-based split and DistributedSampler

setup_logging: setup distributed-aware RotatingFileHandler logging for multi-rank model training experiments
